name: Beyond Mod Manager
notes: Recovers from temporary update-server errors, including HTTP 504, with bounded retries and a verified alternate GitHub asset route.
Bounds stalled downloads, respects server retry limits, and safely restarts interrupted transfers before checking their size and SHA-256.
Fixes updater-helper failures when launched from some PowerShell environments and records errors before replacement.
Keeps BMM usable after an unavailable update and offers Retry update. Includes the UE4SS repair, startup prompts and clean uninstall from 1.0.9.
description: Install and manage Drive Beyond Horizons mods from ZIP files. Keep mod settings, see required support files, and check updates when a mod author provides an update source.
